channel.desc: When Samantha learned D'Angelo cheated, she destroyed his clothes in anger; D'Angelo admits he stepped out but says he only did so because he felt ignored; he now swears he's done with cheating and is prepared to unlock his phone to show he's telling the truth; Nikki is shaken after discovering that Ashley might not be her biological niece; Ashley, who has long felt like an outsider, is ready to confront nearly three decades of unanswered questions.
